p.title: Responsive blocks below the supported desktop width remained in the stylesheet
p.symptom: Six media queries at 1100px and 1200px and one at 1240px collapsed grids to two or three columns, which is tablet handling the product excludes.
p.root_cause: R669 only banned widths below 1100px while AGENTS.md bans breakpoints.
p.fix: The blocks are removed; the 1280px and 1366px adaptations that act at the supported desktop widths stay.
p.violated_rule: Desktop only: do not add breakpoints or mobile handling back (AGENTS.md).
p.prevention: ci-desktop-scope-check and the viewport matrix at 1280/1440/1920.
p.verification: Viewport matrix in the full browser run.
